sections.label: Recycling events household turnout
sections.summary: The first recycling event drew 50 households with about 200 kilogrammes of recyclables, and the second drew over 100 households with about 600 kilogrammes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Foo Cexiang (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: For the first event, we had 50 households turn up with about 200 kilogrammes of recyclables.

sentences.speaker: Mr Foo Cexiang (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: For the second event, we had more than 100 households turn up with about 600 kilogrammes of recyclables.

sections.label: Spottiswoode Park Participatory Budgeting pilot
sections.summary: Last month the speaker partnered IPS on a Participatory Budgeting pilot in Spottiswoode Park estate with a $200,000 budget for residents' neighbourhood ideas.

sentences.speaker: Mr Foo Cexiang (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: Just last month, I partnered the Institute of Policy Studies (IPS) to conduct a Participatory Budgeting (PB) pilot in Spottiswoode Park estate.

sentences.speaker: Mr Foo Cexiang (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: We set aside a budget of $200,000; residents develop and pitch ideas on enhancements for their neighbourhood.

sections.label: Resident turnout at pilot
sections.summary: Close to 200 residents attended, with a range of ages reflecting the estate's general demographics.

sentences.speaker: Mr Foo Cexiang (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: Close to 200 residents turned up, a good range of ages reflecting the general demographics of the estate.

sections.label: Government community initiative funds
sections.summary: The Government has developed funds including the $50 million SG Partnerships Fund, MSE's $50 million SG Eco Fund, and the URA-HDB Lively Places Fund.

sentences.speaker: Mr Foo Cexiang (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: I want to acknowledge the significant effort and investments by the Government in developing a suite of funds to spear and support community-led initiatives.

sentences.speaker: Mr Foo Cexiang (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: These include the $50 million SG Partnerships Fund under the Ministry of Culture, Community and Youth (MCCY), the Ministry of Sustainability and the Environment's (MSE's) $50 million SG Eco Fund to support community-driven sustainability projects, and the Lively Places Fund co-run by the Urban Redevelopment Authority (URA) and the Housing and Development Board (HDB).

sections.label: Social impact based proposal selection
sections.summary: The Government selects proposals based on potential social impact rather than rental bid, awarding selected proposals free use of the property or site for a given tenure.

sentences.speaker: Mr Foo Cexiang (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: Instead of selecting a proposal based on rental bid, the Government chooses proposals based on the proposal's potential social impact.

sentences.speaker: Mr Foo Cexiang (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: The selected proposals are awarded the use of the property or site for a given tenure free of charge.

sections.label: HDB NRP Participatory Budgeting proposal
sections.summary: The speaker hopes HDB will consider enhancing NRP to include a Participatory Budgeting segment so residents can dream, propose and vote for their own ideas.

sentences.speaker: Mr Foo Cexiang (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: With the findings from the Spottiswoode Park NRP+PB, I hope HDB can consider enhancing NRP to also include a segment for PB – so that residents across Singapore have the base layer of NRP improvements, as well as a PB component where they dream, propose and vote for their own ideas.

sections.label: Removing blue bins in Tanjong Pagar-Tiong Bahru
sections.summary: The speaker decided to proceed with removing blue bins after residents raised it, trusting residents and partners to adjust along the way.

sentences.speaker: Mr Foo Cexiang (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: When the residents came to me about removing the blue bins, a dozen scenarios of how it could go wrong crossed my mind.

sentences.speaker: Mr Foo Cexiang (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: Would they be able to agree on the process to find a way forward?

sentences.speaker: Mr Foo Cexiang (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: I thought about each and every one of these concerns and decided to proceed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Foo Cexiang (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: I trusted that they would recognise the heart and efforts of their fellow residents, our community partners and the Government agencies; that they would see that this is something special we are creating in Tanjong Pagar-Tiong Bahru and be prepared to give it a chance as we adjust and improve along the way till we get it.

sentences.speaker: Mr Foo Cexiang (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: And that, Mr Speaker, is what building a democracy of deeds is all about.

sections.label: Shift to government with the people
sections.summary: The shift is from government for the people to government with the people, across citizen participation, volunteerism and citizen-led initiatives.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Goh Hanyan)
sentences.text: To shift the question from "What can the Government do for you?" to "How might we partner together?" This shift – from government for the people, to the government with the people – is something we are actively leaning into, across three fronts: deepening citizen participation in plans and policies; expanding volunteerism; and enabling citizen-led initiatives.

sections.label: Pilots in Boon Lay and Canberra
sections.summary: MCCY, the Ministry of National Development and HDB are piloting ways to deepen engagement under NRP in Boon Lay and Canberra.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Goh Hanyan)
sentences.text: To take this further, MCCY, Ministry of National Development and HDB are piloting different ways to deepen this engagement as part of NRP in Boon Lay and Canberra.

sections.label: Youth Panels introduced in 2023
sections.summary: In 2023 the National Youth Council introduced Youth Panels for young Singaporeans to co-author national initiatives and policies.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Goh Hanyan)
sentences.text: In 2023, the National Youth Council introduced the Youth Panels for young Singaporeans to be co-authors of national initiatives and policies they are passionate about.

sections.label: Youth Corps Leaders and volunteers in 2025
sections.summary: In 2025, over 10,000 Youth Corps Leaders and volunteers contributed more than 75,000 hours, impacting some 6,500 beneficiaries.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Goh Hanyan)
sentences.text: In 2025, more than 10,000 Youth Corps Leaders and volunteers contributed over 75,000 hours of service, impacting some 6,500 beneficiaries.

sections.label: Heritage Activation Nodes and youth grants
sections.summary: Heritage Activation Nodes in three areas mobilised 460 volunteers and nearly 120 partnerships since 2024, and will expand to more neighbourhoods.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Goh Hanyan)
sentences.text: Through the National Heritage Board's Heritage Activation Nodes, community partners and residents in Katong-Joo Chiat, Clementi and Punggol have been creating heritage programmes, mobilising 460 volunteers and forging close to 120 partnerships since 2024.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Goh Hanyan)
sentences.text: We will be expanding these nodes to more neighbourhoods this year, including Tiong Bahru and Telok Blangah.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Goh Hanyan)
sentences.text: What they need from us is access to resources and a system that backs them.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Goh Hanyan)
sentences.text: This is exactly what we are doing through the National Youth Council's Young ChangeMakers Grant, where youths themselves are empowered to evaluate and approve Government funding for projects by fellow Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Goh Hanyan)
sentences.text: A team of 15 youth leaders will be given dedicated spaces and funding to activate these spaces at *SCAPE and the Somerset Belt.
